requirement: Provide a familiar, conflict-safe default mouse navigation grammar while allowing remapping/custom profiles.
acceptance: Default profile: blank LEFT drag in Select mode = marquee; object LEFT drag = move/admitted drag; RIGHT click = context actions; Space+LEFT drag = temporary pan; middle-button drag = pan when supported; wheel = vertical pan/scroll; Shift+wheel = horizontal pan; Ctrl/Cmd+wheel = pointer-centered zoom; fit/zoom remain keyboard accessible. Ctrl/Cmd+LEFT drag pan may be offered as an OPTIONAL remap, not default, because Ctrl/Cmd+click commonly participates in multi-selection.

requirement: Essential Visualize actions must be accessible through multiple coherent routes without creating multiple state owners.
